dedupe_keys.name: zone d influence du nœud de raccordement optique

description: Zone d’influence du Nœud de Raccordement Optique is a dataset listed in Opendata Isère open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de l'Isère. La zone d'influence du nœud de raccordement optique constitue le périmètre de rattachement de chaque NRO. Cette zone est bien souvent constituée d'un regroupement de commune. Coverage: Isère. The portal files it under Développement du territoire. Its keywords are Fibre optique, Noeuds de raccordement optique, THD, Très Haut Débit. The portal shows 103 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-isere-fr-portal.
